policy.goal: Resolve web-retrieval needs by the lowest-cost sufficient capability while making automatic monetary spend impossible by default.
policy.paid_balance_policy: A provider that can consume paid balance or auto-reload is discoverable but not automatically eligible unless a separate hard-stop mechanism proves zero-spend execution.
policy.queue_policy: AI/web-browsing providers are never invoked merely by scrolling or loading queue cards; they run only for an opened candidate after cheaper scholarly and resolved-document layers fail.

pipeline_layers.label: Governed resolved document
pipeline_layers.purpose: Use DOI/publisher/repository/full-text locators already bound to the candidate.

pipeline_layers.label: Free known-URL reader
pipeline_layers.purpose: Convert a known public URL into LLM-readable text and detect an explicit abstract.

pipeline_layers.label: Free SERP discovery
pipeline_layers.purpose: Find publisher/repository/preprint manifestations when the known URL is insufficient.

pipeline_layers.label: Agent-oriented web search
pipeline_layers.purpose: Search and return content or evidence using a bounded AI-oriented search API.

pipeline_layers.label: Rendered browser extraction
pipeline_layers.purpose: Render JavaScript/dynamic pages only after HTTP/read/search fallbacks fail.

pipeline_layers.label: Agentic/deep research
pipeline_layers.purpose: Use autonomous multi-step browsing only for unresolved selected candidates.

pipeline_layers.label: Human/assistant browsing handoff
pipeline_layers.purpose: Record a needs_web_search handoff instead of silently spending money.

providers.label: Jina Reader
providers.free_allowance: 20 RPM without a key; 500 RPM with a free API key
providers.hard_stop_basis: The automatic adapter is keyless by default and performs only Reader requests; rate limiting fails closed.

providers.label: Serper
providers.hard_stop_basis: Adapter remains disabled until the project can prove that only the free grant can be consumed.

providers.label: Tavily Basic
providers.hard_stop_basis: Researcher free-plan requests stop when credits are exhausted; adapter is hard-coded to Basic and rejects responses reporting more than one credit.

providers.label: Exa
providers.free_allowance: $20 signup credit plus $10 credit each month
providers.hard_stop_basis: No automatic adapter until free balance can be isolated from paid/x402 balance by construction.

providers.label: Firecrawl
providers.credential: free account/key or keyless mode where supported
providers.free_allowance: 1,000 credits per month on the Free plan; 5 Agent preview runs per day are advertised separately
providers.hard_stop_basis: Disabled automatically until the production adapter can verify free-plan/keyless execution and auto-reload is impossible.

providers.label: Cloudflare Browser Run
providers.free_allowance: 10 browser minutes per day and 3 concurrent browsers on Workers Free
providers.hard_stop_basis: Workers Free has no excess billing, but the project must verify the production account plan/binding before automatic use.
